`abstract class ToggleNode<F, S>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseToggleNode<F,S>`](/reference/controls/basetogglenode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.toggle` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ToggleNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/toggle/ToggleNode.java)

A toggle made of two parts: a `track` that covers the control and a `knob` that slides from the left (off) to the right (on).

![Two toggles, off and on; the pointer turns the first one on and the second one off, then puts both back](/captures/catalog-controls-togglenode.webp)

## Description

A skin extends it and gives its parts in its constructor; the toggle places them on every frame.
A knob of size `0` takes half the width and the whole height of the toggle.
Attaching a toggle without a knob throws an `IllegalStateException`.

## Creation details

<a id="ToggleNode-constructor"></a>

### ToggleNode

`ToggleNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Creates the toggle at `x`, `y` with a `width` and a `height` in design pixels, from the constructor of a skin.

## Property details

<a id="ToggleNode-property-track"></a>

### track

- `this track(Node track)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Node getTrack()` 

**Default:** 

The node drawn behind the knob, over the whole toggle, with a `zindex` of `-1`; optional.

<a id="ToggleNode-property-knob"></a>

### knob

- `this knob(Node knob)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Node getKnob()` 

**Default:** 

The node that slides along the track and shows the state; required.

<a id="ToggleNode-property-speed"></a>

### speed

- `this speed(float speed)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this speed(Supplier<Float> speed)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `float getSpeed()` 

**Default:** `0.25F`

How fast the knob reaches its new place: the part of the remaining way that it covers in 1/60 s, at any frame rate.
`1F` moves it at once.

## Method details

<a id="ToggleNode-method-getKnobProgress"></a>

### getKnobProgress

`float getKnobProgress()` 

Returns the place of the knob on this frame, from `0F` at the left (off) to `1F` at the right (on).
A skin reads it to make another part follow the knob.

<a id="ToggleNode-method-layout"></a>

### layout

`void layout()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Places the track over the toggle and moves the knob one step toward the side of the state.

<a id="ToggleNode-method-detach"></a>

### detach

`void detach()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Forgets the place of the knob, so that the toggle shows its state at once when it comes back.
